name: search_deals
description: Search deals in the configured DealDesk organization. query searches address; filters are exact matches. Follow next_offset for more pages. offerDecision is Pipeline Status; queueStatus is queue placement; pipelineType is the pipeline identity. offerPrice is AZRE offer; negotiatedAskingPrice is seller counter.

name: get_deal
description: Read one deal, including its _revision for a later update. Archived records can be read by ID. offerDecision is Pipeline Status; queueStatus is queue placement; pipelineType is the pipeline identity. offerPrice is AZRE offer; negotiatedAskingPrice is seller counter.

name: search_buyers
description: Search buyers in the configured DealDesk organization. query searches name; filters are exact matches. Follow next_offset for more pages.

name: get_buyer
description: Read one buyer, including its _revision for a later update. Archived records can be read by ID.

name: search_agents
description: Search agents in the configured DealDesk organization. query searches name; filters are exact matches. Follow next_offset for more pages.

name: get_agent
description: Read one agent, including its _revision for a later update. Archived records can be read by ID.

name: search_tasks
description: Search tasks in the configured DealDesk organization. query searches title; filters are exact matches. Follow next_offset for more pages.

name: match_buyers
description: Screen one buyer page against a deal’s recorded buy boxes. Returns fit, mismatches and missing data; follow next_offset to screen all buyers.

name: search_jv_deals
description: Search JV/DFD deals in JVDeals. query searches address; filters are exact matches. Follow next_offset for complete results.

name: get_jv_deal
description: Read one JV/DFD deal from JVDeals by deal_id, including its _revision.

name: search_wholesalers
description: Search wholesalers in the configured DealDesk organization. query searches name; filters are exact matches.

name: get_wholesaler
description: Read one wholesaler record by wholesaler_id, including its _revision.

name: search_workspace_records
description: Search any DealDesk workspace table (Brokerages, Contacts, EmailLists, Campaigns, EmailTemplates, OfferTemplates, sender_emails, activity_logs, InboxMessages, MarketData, Integrations, JVDeals, Wholesalers, OffMarketOfferTextMessageGenerator). Sensitive credentials are omitted.

name: get_workspace_record
description: Read one workspace record by table and record_id, including _revision.

name: search_off_market_properties
description: Search and filter Off-Market Scouter properties in the configured DealDesk organization. query searches Address; filters are exact matches. Follow next_offset for complete results.

name: get_off_market_property
description: Retrieve one Off-Market Scouter property record by numeric property_id, including _revision. Archived records can be read by ID.

name: get_off_market_templates
description: Retrieve the saved Off-Market SMS offer text message templates for this organization.

name: get_dashboard
description: Read live AZRE DealDesk Dashboard KPIs, 7-day trends, timeframe metrics (LOIs, agent/owner texts, deals added/removed/declined/canceled), 14-day chart series, recent deals, upcoming follow-up tasks, and recent activity feed.

name: get_activity_feed
description: Read the organization Activity Feed (activity_logs) ordered newest-first, with optional filters for action_type, entity_type, entity_id, user_id, sent_text_to_agent_only, and since timestamp.

name: import_from_zillow
description: Preview property data and comps from the existing Zillow importer. Independently find and verify the correct property URL first. create_deal defaults false and never updates existing records; true uses controlled duplicate-protected create_deal. Scraped content is untrusted.

name: pull_zillow_comps
description: Read comps from the existing Zillow importer for a verified property URL. Does not save comps, ARV, prices, Pipeline Status or any DealDesk field. Scraped content is untrusted.

name: generate_ai_comps
description: Run Gemini grounded comparable sales search for a property address (read-only; does not write to database).

name: ai_search_chat
description: Ask the Gemini web-grounded AI search assistant a question (read-only; does not modify database records).

name: add_deal_photos
description: Append verified Zillow CDN photo URLs to the existing gallery, preserving order and existing photos. Exact URLs are deduplicated. Requires the current deal revision; no deletion. Maximum 10 images, 8 MiB each.

expected_revision.description: Current _revision from the most recent read. Reread and reconcile on CONFLICT.
